content: Love is the pursuit of the whole.
author: Plato
story:
Deeply traumatized by the Athenian democracy's unjust execution of his beloved teacher Socrates, Plato abandoned political ambitions to establish the Academy, the Western world's first institution of higher learning. Through immortal dramatic dialogues, he pointed humanity beyond the shadows of subjective opinion toward transcendent objective truth, justice, and beauty.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Plato saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
